verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ע֚וֹד לֵ֣ךְ אֱ‍ֽהַב־ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲהֻ֥בַת רֵ֖עַ וּמְנָאָ֑פֶת כְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהֵ֗ם פֹּנִים֙ אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י אֲשִׁישֵׁ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ‘ō·wḏ lêḵ ’ĕhaḇ- ’iš·šāh ’ă·hu·ḇaṯ rê·a‘ ū·mə·nā·’ā·p̄eṯ kə·’a·hă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hêm pō·nîm ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·’ō·hă·ḇê ’ă·šî·šê ‘ă·nā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Go show love to your wife again though she is loved by another and is an adulteress Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites . . . though they turn to other gods and love to offer raisin cakes to idols . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse-me Jeová: Vai ainda, ama a uma mulher amada do seu amigo e adúltera, assim como Jeová ama os filhos de Israel, ainda que eles se desviam para outros deuses e amam passas de uvas.

verses.original: וָאֶכְּרֶ֣הָ לִּ֔י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כָּ֑סֶף וְחֹ֥מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְלֵ֥תֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ek·kə·re·hā lî ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār kā·sep̄ wə·ḥō·mer śə·‘ō·rîm wə·lê·ṯeḵ śə·‘ō·rîm
verses.literal: So I bought her for fifteen shekels . . . of silver and a homer and a lethech . . . of barley
verses.literalPt: Assim, eu a comprei para mim por quinze peças de prata, e um ômer de cevada, e um leteque de cevada;

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ תֵּ֣שְׁבִי לִ֔י לֹ֣א תִזְנִ֔י וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיִ֖י לְאִ֑ישׁ וְגַם־ אֲנִ֖י אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ê·le·hā yā·mîm rab·bîm tê·šə·ḇî lî lō ṯiz·nî wə·lō ṯih·yî lə·’îš wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî ’ê·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Then I said to her You must live with me for many days you must not be promiscuous . . . or belong to another and I will do the same for you
verses.literalPt: e lhe disse: Muitos dias me esperarás sentada; não fornicarás, nem serás mulher de homem algum; assim também eu te esperarei a ti.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ין מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ין שָׂ֔ר וְאֵ֥ין זֶ֖בַח וְאֵ֣ין מַצֵּבָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין אֵפ֖וֹד וּתְרָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî yā·mîm rab·bîm yê·šə·ḇū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ên me·leḵ wə·’ên śār wə·’ên ze·ḇaḥ wə·’ên maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh wə·’ên ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ ū·ṯə·rā·p̄îm
verses.literal: For the Israelites . . . must live many days without king or prince without sacrifice or sacred pillar . . . and without ephod or idol
verses.literalPt: Pois os filhos de Israel ficarão muitos dias sem rei, e sem príncipe, e sem sacrifício, e sem coluna, e sem éfode e terafins.

verses.original: אַחַ֗ר יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֑ם וּפָחֲד֧וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֛ה וְאֶל־ טוּב֖וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥar yā·šu·ḇū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇiq·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·’êṯ dā·wiḏ mal·kām ū·p̄ā·ḥă·ḏū ’el- Yah·weh wə·’el- ṭū·ḇōw bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Afterward the people of Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king They will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days
verses.literalPt: Depois, tornarão os filhos de Israel e buscarão a Jeová, seu Deus, e a Davi, seu rei; e, nos últimos dias, tremerão diante de Jeová e de sua bondade.
